core.title: Training yard
core.route: Use the center lane or pass behind cover to reach the landing.

heist.title: Demolition block
heist.route: Follow the street to the vault or enter by the service alley.

industrial.title: Foundry yard
industrial.route: Move stock through the loading lane. Use the steps to reach the machine bay.

security.title: Transit checkpoint
security.route: Use the inspection lane or the side gate to reach the control room.

creatures.title: Ranger outpost
creatures.route: Cross the stream and pass through the pen to reach the field station.

fantasy.title: Market keep
fantasy.route: Enter the market, pass the stalls, and climb to the shrine.
